import subprocess
# Switch back to work branch
result = subprocess.run(["git", "checkout", "work"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(result.stdout)

# Run all tests
result = subprocess.run(
    ["python", "-m", "pytest", "-v", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", 
     "tests/test_cache.py", "tests/test_cached.py", "tests/test_cachedmethod.py",
     "tests/test_fifo.py", "tests/test_func.py", "tests/test_keys.py",
     "tests/test_lfu.py", "tests/test_lru.py", "tests/test_mru.py",
     "tests/test_rr.py", "tests/test_tlru.py", "tests/test_ttl.py"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
# Find failures
lines = result.stdout.split('\n')
failures = [l for l in lines if 'FAILED' in l or 'ERROR' in l]
print("Failures:")
for f in failures[:50]:
    print(f)
print(f"\nTotal output length: {len(result.stdout)}")
